The issuer demonstrates solid top-line revenue ($1.82B) and strong operating profitability with an EBIT of $371M (20.3% margin), though net income is lower at $67M. While the company maintains a manageable leverage profile with total assets of $10.15B against liabilities of $7.24B (equity of $2.87B), there is short-term liquidity tightness indicated by current assets of $475M compared to current liabilities of $857M. Taking into account the strong operating cash generation potential offset by weaker current liquidity and lower net margins, the issuer presents an investment-grade risk profile.

DECISION: BBB
